caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of the Whisper model with different types of fine-tuning, specifically for the full type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents WER, also with a linear scale, spanning from 20 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines: the gray dotted line with triangle markers represents "tiny full" and starts at approximately 29 WER at epoch 0, decreasing to around 23 WER at epoch 6, with a notable drop between epochs 2 and 3 from about 27 to 24 WER; the blue dotted line with triangle markers represents "base full" and begins at roughly 22 WER at epoch 0, decreasing to approximately 19 WER at epoch 6, with a slight increase between epochs 1 and 2 from about 21 to 21.5 WER before continuing its overall downward trend.
